tickmill.t011: Hedging is mandatory, not netting. The two algorithms work independently and may hold opposing positions on one instrument; on a netting account the second trade would close the first, and the result would diverge from the strategy.

monitor.t008:
Every week the watcher algorithm checks two numbers
  and compares them against thresholds set in advance. The result of every check
  is published here.
monitor.t009:
The feed will start filling up together with live trading.
Each entry: date of the check, current drawdown, expectancy over the last 100 trades, status under the rules and the actions taken.
monitor.t011: Drawdown answers the question “how much does it hurt right now”. Thresholds: up to 27% — normal, 27–34% — attention, 34–41% — review, above 41% — trading halted.
monitor.t012: Expectancy over 100 trades answers the question “is the system still working”. The alarm threshold is below −0.05% per trade.
monitor.t013: The number of trades is reconciled against the expected one: this is how a stopped or hung algorithm is detected, which would otherwise look simply like a prolonged drawdown.
